svg.title: Normal Conduction, state 5: T2 + T3
svg.desc: Editable SCR rectifier conduction paths. Red highlights electrically closed forward-only SCR loops. In inverter operation, current enters DC+ and leaves DC-; the external DC source provides energy to the AC grid. Overlap shows connectivity, not instantaneous current sharing.

g.text: T2 + T3 | one upper and one lower SCR carry the DC current
Conceptual model only: ideal sinusoidal sources, constant DC current, linear current transfer during overlap; equal-reactance voltage average. Not an EMT solution.
